title: Prepare the outer word
statement: Let $\mathrm{mode}$ be Boolean, let $h$ be a bit string, and let $zlen$ and $q$ be natural numbers satisfying $2zlen+2\le |h|$ and $q\le 2|h|$. Starting with the machine in copy stage $3$ with pointer and tail both $2zlen+2$, query value $q$, and all other registers zero except the second register, which is $|h|$, it reaches scan stage $1$ with pointer zero, second register $|h|$, end-marker register $2zlen$, query value $q$, and tail value $2zlen+2$; all remaining registers are zero. The result remains unset, and every intermediate configuration before the final one satisfies the machine's safety condition and has all register values at most $4|h|+4$.
